card.name: Numbers and degrees before hyphenated lists
card.fires_on: Ordinal or number words (second, first, 5, 8) that start a hyphenated pair such as "second- or third-degree" or "2-, 5-, and 3-fold", mainly in drug-interaction and heart-block text.

modes.label: Fold-change numbers
modes.description: A digit in a fold increase of drug exposure, right before a hyphen or decimal continuation.
modes.example: C max , AUC, and T ½ by an average of approximately 2-, <<5>>-, and 3-fold, respectively.

modes.label: Degree of AV block
modes.description: An ordinal like second or first before "-degree" or "or third degree" in heart block wording.

card.writes: It favors a following hyphen with and/or, or an opening brace, continuing a paired or listed expression.
card.plain: It fires on a number or ordinal that begins a pair like "second- or third-degree" or "2- and 3-fold".
